claim_being_audited: Whether certifying the current model release is compliant because aggregate readiness passed and rehearsal showed no severity-one incidents, despite a current loan-modification segment weakness and no documented approved mitigation or current-release disclosure in the available record.
decision_criteria: If current release documentation already reflects the current evaluation results and explicitly discloses the material segment weakness, the compliance case strengthens materially.
If there is an approved mitigation or formal risk acceptance covering the segment weakness, certification could meet the stated policy.
If neither disclosure nor approved mitigation exists for the current release, certification does not meet the policy threshold.
Aggregate pass and clean rehearsal are supportive but not sufficient when a required disclosure or mitigation predicate is unresolved.
evidence_requests: Current release model-card or release documentation showing the current evaluation results.
The exact disclosure text for the loan-modification segment weakness in the current release documentation.
Any approved mitigation, formal risk acceptance, or owner sign-off covering the segment weakness.
The underlying evaluation report establishing materiality and the 1.4 percentage-point gap for the named launch use case.
specific_concerns: The governing policy requires current release documentation to reflect current evaluation results and to disclose material segment weaknesses or cover them with an approved mitigation.
The actor summary itself says the loan modification support slice is 1.4 percentage points below the warning threshold.
The actor summary also says the release thread contains only an informal monitoring comment and no reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or disclosure language.
Prior approval of the same model family is explicitly described as context only and not a substitute for current evidence.
Because evidence access is limited to the actor summary, there is no admissible proof here that the current release documentation was actually updated before certification.
unsupported_claims: That certification is compliant on the present record.
That aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one incidents are sufficient by themselves under the stated policy.
That the current segment weakness is already properly disclosed or covered by approved mitigation.
